definitions.explanation: A product, flavor, or menu item available only during a particular season, common for food, beverages, and snacks in Japan.

examples.japanese: {季節|きせつ}{限定|げんてい}フレーバーが{出|で}た。
examples.english: A seasonal limited flavor was released.

examples.japanese: {桜|さくら}{味|あじ}の{季節|きせつ}{限定|げんてい}スイーツを{食|た}べた。
examples.english: I had the seasonal limited cherry blossom flavored sweets.

examples.japanese: {季節|きせつ}{限定|げんてい}メニューは{今月|こんげつ}までです。
examples.english: The seasonal menu is only available until the end of this month.

notes:
{季節|きせつ}{限定|げんてい} products are extremely popular in Japan. Convenience stores, fast food chains, and snack manufacturers regularly release seasonal flavors like {桜|さくら} (cherry blossom) in spring and {栗|くり} (chestnut) in autumn.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {季節|きせつ}{限定|げんてい}メニュー (seasonal limited menu)
- {季節|きせつ}{限定|げんてい}フレーバー (seasonal limited flavor)
- {季節|きせつ}{限定|げんてい}{商品|しょうひん} (seasonal limited product)

RELATED WORDS:
- {期間|きかん}{限定|げんてい}: limited time
- {春|はる}{限定|げんてい}: spring only
- {新作|しんさく}: new product
